versions.title: Vampires: complete layered faction artwork

groups.name: Visuals
items: All 16 Vampire units now have six-direction layered artwork, animated equipment and matching combat effects.
Bat swarms retain three members; the Bat King has a separate bat rig. Warlock transformation and the Blood Hunter mount are animated.
Drain, tether, charm, concealment, healing and mana effects follow successful gameplay events.
Preview the full faction with ?arttest=factions&faction=vamp or inspect individual poses in the animation workshop.

groups.name: Fixes
items: Updated art files use revisioned URLs so corrected atlases refresh on clients.
Effects respect fog, pause and match cleanup; unit artwork scales with board zoom.

commits: Complete Vampire faction layered art and combat effects

versions.title: Kingdom: complete layered character artwork

groups.name: Visuals
items: All 17 Kingdom units now use six-direction layered artwork with animated body parts and separate equipment.
Outriders have articulated horses and seated riders. High Seraphs have separate wings and halos. Soldier squads retain their three-member formations.
New attack, projectile, healing, spell, aura and movement effects follow real combat events, including elite cinematic attacks.
The animation workshop previews each available character's directions and movable parts. A Kingdom test match places the complete faction on both sides.
Updated terrain and the existing Pyromancer, Bloodblade and Necromancer art pilots are included. Other faction overhauls are still in progress.

groups.name: Fixes
items: Character artwork scales consistently with board zoom. Weapon animation canvases have extra room for long equipment.
Local battles pause through the in-game menu, including pending AI turns. Online matches continue while the menu is open.
New effects respect fog visibility, pause, reduced-motion settings and match cleanup.

commits: Complete Kingdom layered art, animation and combat effects

versions.title: No attacks into the fog

groups.name: Balance
items: Fog of war: you can only attack hexes you can see. Towers, buildings and walls hidden in the fog can't be hit, and attack spells and Silence need a revealed target hex. Flares, heals and summons work as before

commits: Fog of war: no attacks into the fog

versions.title: Sudden death toggle

groups.name: Features
items: Sudden death is now a match option, on by default. Turn it off and towers never crumble on their own, and you can repair and fortify them for the whole match

commits: Sudden death is now a match option (on by default)

versions.title: Tower tap fix

groups.name: Fixes
items: Tapping or clicking the hex just above a tower or wall works again (the new tower art was catching the tap)

commits: Towers and walls no longer block taps on the hex above them

versions.title: Cheaper Bone Legion

groups.name: Balance
items: Bone Legion costs 4 gold again and takes 1 slot (was 5 gold, 2 slots)
Your army can never grow past 50 slots, whatever you build

commits: Bone Legion back to 4 gold (1 slot); army cap can never go above 50

versions.title: Undead bosses buffed

groups.name: Balance
items: Bone Colossus: moves 3 (was 1) and deals 8 damage (was 7)
Plague Lord: moves 3 (was 2) and has 28 HP (was 25)
Death Knight: deals 6 damage (was 5) and has 25 HP (was 22)

commits: Boss balance: buff the weak Undead bosses (Bone Colossus, Plague Lord, Death Knight)

versions.title: Standing forests and painted buildings

groups.name: Visuals
items: Forests are real woods now: every forest hex has standing oaks, pines, birches or an old hollow oak with bushes and ferns, on a new forest-floor tile
Heroes in a forest stand among the bushes: the front ones are drawn over their legs, in both Classic and Tilted view
While you pick a move or a target, the tree crowns turn see-through so the highlighted hexes stay easy to read
New painted towers with banners in your colour; they crack and then break and smoke as they lose HP
New painted buildings: Farm, Watchtower, Barracks, Mana Well, Cottage, Great Hall and the Open Grave, plus Stonewright walls and the Iron Cage
Gold mines, shrines and treasure chests have new painted art; a mine's flag shows who owns it

groups.name: Balance
items: Price changes to even out the factions: Royal Lookout, Stonewright, Royal Herald and Knight now cost 5 gold; Eye of Ruin, Boar Rider, Trapper and Cinder Warden 7; Stormcaller is cheaper at 4

commits: Painted forests and new structure art
Gold prices: faction re-check after the AI fixes and fireproof Infernals

versions.title: Phone fix

groups.name: Fixes
items: Phone: tapping a glowing hex to spawn or move works again on the zoomed board

commits: Phone: fix taps on the zoomed board doing nothing (spawning, moving)

versions.title: Faster spawning, fireproof Infernals and a bigger phone board

groups.name: New
items: After you spawn a hero, the next one from your reserve is picked for you: another copy of the same hero if you have one, otherwise the next hero in line

groups.name: Balance
items: Infernal heroes are fireproof: they never burn, and Wall of Flame, Rain of Fire, Fireball cards, Pit Lord's Immolation and a dragon's fly-over do not hurt them. Normal attacks still do

groups.name: Visuals
items: Phone: battles open zoomed in with bigger hexes, centred on your towers. Drag to look around, or use − for the whole map
Phone: heroes are drawn a little smaller so they sit inside their own hex
Phone: a tap always picks the hex closest to your finger, so it is much easier to pick where to move

commits: Infernal heroes take no damage from fire abilities
Infernal heroes are immune to burning
Phone board: bigger tiles, smaller figures, taps snap to the nearest hex
Spawning: after a spawn, the next reserve hero is picked for you
